item.title: These 12 Artists Reached No. 2 on the Hot 100 With Their First Hit — Then Never Made the Chart Again
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to this week's podcast, where we're shining the spotlight on a unique group of artists who reached the pinnacle of success, but just missed the top spot. You know the names: Bob Dylan, Bruce Springsteen, and Missy Elliott, to name a few, have all gotten close to a number one hit on the Billboard Hot 100, but never quite made it.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: But what about the artists who made it to number two, only to never return to the chart again? Over the nearly 70-year history of the Hot 100, over a dozen artists have achieved this feat with their very first entry. They're the true one-hit wonders, and we're here to tell their story.
[Music transitions to a brief pause]
Host: From Creedence Clearwater Revival to The Isley Brothers, and from Dua Lipa to other iconic artists, many have had multiple hits on the chart. But not these 12 artists. They cracked the code once, reaching the number two spot, and then... nothing. No follow-up hits, no return visits. Just a single, shining moment in the spotlight.
[Music fades back in]
Host: So, let's take a moment to appreciate the difficulty of making it onto the Hot 100, even if it's just once. And to these 12 artists, we salute you. Your achievement may have been short-lived, but it's an accomplishment nonetheless. Tune in next time as we explore more fascinating stories from the world of music.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: Thanks for listening, and don't forget to check out our list of 100 favorite number two hits, featuring some of the most iconic artists of all time.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
